text:
sam_w: heads up — CI started failing on linux-builder after yesterday's deps bump. failing wheel build for tokenizers and a fastapi import error in integration tests. i think it's related to CVE-2025-1234 and the pinned constraints we pushed.
ingrid_l: CVE-2025-1234? quick summary? :eyes:
maya: tokenizers issue is a vuln in its native wheel handling; affects <=0.12.7 per advisory. patch 0.12.8 released.
calvin_r: fastapi import error sounds like starlette/uvicorn ABI mismatch that popped up when pip pulled a newer starlette. may be a transitive from poetry constraints.
sam_w: security advisory linked here: https://example.com/CVE-2025-1234 — exploit is local deserialization in tokenizers binary extension. severity: high.
security-bot: [alert] CVE-2025-1234 severity=HIGH affected_packages=[tokenizers<=0.12.7] recommended_action=upgrade-or-backport
ci-bot: build #9823 failed on step 'build_wheels' with exit code 1. logs attached.
ingrid_l: OK, two things to coordinate: 1) prioritize CVE fix for tokenizers for hosted api and dedicated images; 2) fix CI constraint so we don't pull an incompatible starlette during lock regen.
maya: i can cut a quick PR to bump tokenizers to 0.12.8 in pyproject.toml and regenerate lock. will run full integration suite.
calvin_r: hold on regen — our poetry lock currently has a pinned starlette==0.19.1 due to a dev dependency. if regen without constraints we might end up on 0.22.x which breaks our uvicorn pins. we need to add a constraints file or explicit constraint in pyproject.
sam_w: proposed plan: maya bumps tokenizers, calvin adds a constraints.txt for CI pip installs to force starlette 0.19.x until we validate 0.22. then regen lock and run smoke. if all green, we can relax constraints and schedule starlette upgrade.
maya: working on PR now. draft branch: patch/tokenizers-0.12.8-lock-regen. i'll include this in changelog and note the CVE.
calvin_r: for CI quickfix, i can add a step that applies a constraints file before pip installs:
```
# ci/constraints.txt
starlette==0.19.1
# keep uvicorn pinned as well
uvicorn==0.18.3
```
calvin_r: then in CI: `pip install -r requirements.txt -c ci/constraints.txt` — locks pip behavior while we regen poetry.
ingrid_l: good. also need to ensure our dedicated container builds (private infra) pick up the patched wheel. maya, please publish a staging wheel or tag for ops to pick up.
maya: will build a staging wheel and upload to our internal repo at s3://redwood-artifacts/tokenizers/0.12.8-postfix. tagging as tokenizers-0.12.8-rw1.
security-bot: [note] mark customer-impact = maybe (hosted customers on older images). recommend notifying support if we need to rotate deployments.
sam_w: is there an acceptable short-term mitigation besides upgrade? backport patch?
maya: tokenizers maintainers published the patch only in a new release. there's no small patch to cherry-pick that compiles easily for our many platforms. upgrade is the path.
calvin_r: for pinned environments we can rebuild images with the new wheel and redeploy. that'll take few hours for staging and longer for prod.
devops: i can queue the rebuild for staging once you confirm artifact location. add me to the PR.
ingrid_l: priorities: P0 for hosted control plane images, P1 for dedicated/reserved images, P2 for private on-prem customers (coordinate with account teams).
sam_w: agreement on timeline? maya — can you have PR + wheels within 2 hours? calvin — can you land CI constraint hotfix first to unbreak master?
maya: yes, PR in ~1.5h with wheels uploaded to staging. i'll include test matrix results.
calvin_r: constraint change to CI in 20m, i'll open small PR and tag @devops and @ci-bot for quick merge.
ci-bot: ci quickfix PR #10432 opened by calvin_r, tests pending.
security-bot: please add the CVE ID and affected sha to the PR description for audit logging.
calvin_r: added CVE-2025-1234 and link to advisory in PR body. also added a note to the release checklist to update the SBOM.
ingrid_l: once PRs are merged, update the incident tracker with mitigation steps and timeline. sam, can you own the customer notification draft if we need to notify?
sam_w: yep. i'll draft a short notification for support and account teams once staging rebuilds validated.
maya: quick note — when regenerating poetry.lock, i used `poetry lock --no-update` initially and that kept constraints; to force bump tokenizers i used: `poetry add tokenizers@0.12.8 --lock`. sharing commands in case others need them.
calvin_r: and for anyone using pip in CI, to regenerate constraints from poetry we can run `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes > requirements.txt` then apply `-c ci/constraints.txt` while installing.
devops: queued staging rebuild, i'll watch wheels S3 path and kick deploy once available.
ci-bot: CI quickfix merged, master build unblocked.
maya: PR for tokenizers bump opened: #10433 — includes lock regen, tests, artifact link.
security-bot: [audit] recorded change tokenizers 0.12.7 -> 0.12.8 by maya; CVE-2025-1234 mitigation=upgrade; timestamp=1776543275
calvin_r: after this stabilizes let's add an automated check in deps-scan to flag native extension wheel CVEs and mark them for image rebuilds.
ingrid_l: agreed. also follow up action: run SBOM diff and Q/A on model-serving images. add to secure-sweep next week.
sam_w: thanks all — marking this thread resolved once staging rebuild passes. :thumbsup:
maya: resolving on my side after prod rollout.
calvin_r: i'll open a follow-up ticket to plan starlette upgrade window.
devops: staging deploy passed smoke tests at 1776543270.
sam_w: closing thread when prod completes.
